package dialog

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"net/url"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/google/uuid"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain/repository"
)

const maximumResponseBytes = 8 << 20

type Client struct {
	BaseURL       string
	InternalToken string
	SpaceKey      string
	HTTPClient    *http.Client
}

type ensureDialogResponse struct {
	ID                 string          `json:"id"`
	SpaceID            string          `json:"space_id"`
	Type               int             `json:"type"`
	Status             int             `json:"status"`
	Title              string          `json:"title"`
	StudentID          *string         `json:"student_id"`
	PersonalTeacherID  *string         `json:"personal_teacher_id"`
	ContextType        string          `json:"context_type"`
	ContextID          *string         `json:"context_id"`
	Version            int             `json:"version"`
	MemberCount        int             `json:"member_count"`
	MessageCount       int64           `json:"message_count"`
	MaxMessageSequence int64           `json:"max_message_sequence"`
	MaxEventSequence   int64           `json:"max_event_sequence"`
	LastMessageID      *string         `json:"last_message_id"`
	LastMessageAt      *time.Time      `json:"last_message_at"`
	CurrentMember      json.RawMessage `json:"current_member"`
	Members            json.RawMessage `json:"members"`
	CreatedAt          time.Time       `json:"created_at"`
	UpdatedAt          time.Time       `json:"updated_at"`
}

type messageResponse struct {
	ID                string                       `json:"id"`
	DialogID          string                       `json:"dialog_id"`
	AuthorType        string                       `json:"author_type"`
	Channel           string                       `json:"channel"`
	SenderID          *string                      `json:"sender_id"`
	PersonalTeacherID *string                      `json:"personal_teacher_id"`
	LearningActionID  *string                      `json:"learning_action_id"`
	LessonContext     *domain.LessonMessageContext `json:"lesson_context"`
	AssistantUI       json.RawMessage              `json:"assistant_ui"`
	ReplyToMessageID  *string                      `json:"reply_to_message_id"`
	Body              string                       `json:"body"`
	Links             []linkResponse               `json:"links"`
	Status            int                          `json:"status"`
	Version           int                          `json:"version"`
	MessageSequence   int64                        `json:"message_sequence"`
	LastEventSequence int64                        `json:"last_event_sequence"`
	Attachments       []attachmentResponse         `json:"attachments"`
	EditedAt          *time.Time                   `json:"edited_at"`
	DeletedAt         *time.Time                   `json:"deleted_at"`
	CreatedAt         time.Time                    `json:"created_at"`
	UpdatedAt         time.Time                    `json:"updated_at"`
}

type linkResponse struct {
	URL string `json:"url"`
}

type attachmentResponse struct {
	ID               string `json:"id"`
	Kind             int    `json:"kind"`
	Status           int    `json:"status"`
	MIMEType         string `json:"mime_type"`
	SizeBytes        int64  `json:"size_bytes"`
	Width            *int   `json:"width"`
	Height           *int   `json:"height"`
	OriginalFilename string `json:"original_filename"`
}

type requestContextResponse struct {
	DialogID          string            `json:"dialog_id"`
	StudentID         string            `json:"student_id"`
	PersonalTeacherID string            `json:"personal_teacher_id"`
	ContextType       string            `json:"context_type"`
	ContextID         *string           `json:"context_id"`
	SourceMessageID   string            `json:"source_message_id"`
	LearningActionID  *string           `json:"learning_action_id"`
	Messages          []messageResponse `json:"messages"`
}

func (client Client) EnsureTeacherDialog(
	ctx context.Context,
	studentID string,
	personalTeacherID string,
	contextType domain.LearningContextType,
	contextID string,
) (domain.TeacherDialogBinding, error) {
	studentID = strings.TrimSpace(studentID)
	personalTeacherID = strings.TrimSpace(personalTeacherID)
	contextID = strings.TrimSpace(contextID)
	candidate := domain.TeacherDialogBinding{
		ID: uuid.NewString(), StudentID: studentID, PersonalTeacherID: personalTeacherID,
		ContextType: contextType, ContextID: contextID,
	}
	if _, err := domain.NewTeacherDialogBinding(candidate); err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherDialogBinding{}, err
	}
	dialogContextType := string(contextType)
	if contextType == domain.LearningContextGeneral {
		dialogContextType = "general_teacher"
	}
	payload := map[string]any{
		"space_key": client.SpaceKey, "student_id": studentID,
		"personal_teacher_id": personalTeacherID, "context_type": dialogContextType,
	}
	if contextID != "" {
		payload["context_id"] = contextID
	}
	body, err := json.Marshal(payload)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherDialogBinding{}, domain.ErrInvalidDialogContext
	}
	endpoint, err := client.endpoint("/internal/v1/teacher-dialog/ensure")
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherDialogBinding{}, err
	}
	httpRequest, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodPut, endpoint, bytes.NewReader(body))
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherDialogBinding{}, unavailable(err)
	}
	httpRequest.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	client.authorize(httpRequest)
	response, err := client.do(httpRequest)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherDialogBinding{}, err
	}
	defer func() { _ = response.Body.Close() }()
	if response.StatusCode != http.StatusOK && response.StatusCode != http.StatusCreated {
		return domain.TeacherDialogBinding{}, mapStatus(response.StatusCode, response.Status)
	}
	var responsePayload ensureDialogResponse
	if err := decodeStrict(response.Body, &responsePayload); err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherDialogBinding{}, unavailable(err)
	}
	returnedContextType, err := normalizeContextType(responsePayload.ContextType)
	if err != nil || responsePayload.StudentID == nil || responsePayload.PersonalTeacherID == nil {
		return domain.TeacherDialogBinding{}, unavailable(domain.ErrInvalidDialogContext)
	}
	binding, err := domain.NewTeacherDialogBinding(domain.TeacherDialogBinding{
		ID: responsePayload.ID, StudentID: *responsePayload.StudentID,
		PersonalTeacherID: *responsePayload.PersonalTeacherID, ContextType: returnedContextType,
		ContextID: optional(responsePayload.ContextID), Created: response.StatusCode == http.StatusCreated,
	})
	if err != nil || binding.StudentID != studentID || binding.PersonalTeacherID != personalTeacherID ||
		binding.ContextType != contextType || binding.ContextID != contextID {
		return domain.TeacherDialogBinding{}, unavailable(domain.ErrInvalidDialogContext)
	}
	return binding, nil
}

func (client Client) GetTeacherRequestContext(ctx context.Context, request domain.DialogTeacherRequest, before int) (domain.DialogRequestContext, error) {
	normalized, err := domain.NewDialogTeacherRequest(request)
	if err != nil || before < 0 || before >= 50 {
		return domain.DialogRequestContext{}, domain.ErrInvalidDialogContext
	}
	endpoint, err := client.endpoint("/internal/v1/teacher-dialog/" + url.PathEscape(normalized.DialogID) +
		"/request/" + url.PathEscape(normalized.SourceMessageID))
	if err != nil {
		return domain.DialogRequestContext{}, err
	}
	parsed, err := url.Parse(endpoint)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.DialogRequestContext{}, unavailable(err)
	}
	query := parsed.Query()
	query.Set("personal_teacher_id", normalized.PersonalTeacherID)
	query.Set("before", strconv.Itoa(before))
	parsed.RawQuery = query.Encode()
	httpRequest, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodGet, parsed.String(), nil)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.DialogRequestContext{}, unavailable(err)
	}
	client.authorize(httpRequest)
	response, err := client.do(httpRequest)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.DialogRequestContext{}, err
	}
	defer func() { _ = response.Body.Close() }()
	if response.StatusCode != http.StatusOK {
		return domain.DialogRequestContext{}, mapStatus(response.StatusCode, response.Status)
	}
	var payload requestContextResponse
	if err := decodeStrict(response.Body, &payload); err != nil {
		return domain.DialogRequestContext{}, unavailable(err)
	}
	contextType, err := normalizeContextType(payload.ContextType)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.DialogRequestContext{}, unavailable(err)
	}
	messages := make([]domain.DialogMessage, 0, len(payload.Messages))
	for _, item := range payload.Messages {
		messages = append(messages, toDomainMessage(item))
	}
	result, err := domain.NewDialogRequestContext(domain.DialogRequestContext{
		DialogID: payload.DialogID, StudentID: payload.StudentID, PersonalTeacherID: payload.PersonalTeacherID,
		ContextType: contextType, ContextID: optional(payload.ContextID), SourceMessageID: payload.SourceMessageID,
		LearningActionID: optional(payload.LearningActionID), Messages: messages,
	})
	if err != nil || result.DialogID != normalized.DialogID || result.StudentID != normalized.StudentID ||
		result.PersonalTeacherID != normalized.PersonalTeacherID || result.ContextType != normalized.ContextType ||
		result.ContextID != normalized.ContextID || result.SourceMessageID != normalized.SourceMessageID ||
		result.LearningActionID != normalized.LearningActionID {
		return domain.DialogRequestContext{}, unavailable(domain.ErrInvalidDialogContext)
	}
	source := result.Messages[len(result.Messages)-1]
	if source.MessageSequence != normalized.SourceSequence || source.LastEventSequence < normalized.EventSequence {
		return domain.DialogRequestContext{}, unavailable(domain.ErrInvalidDialogContext)
	}
	return result, nil
}

func (client Client) AppendTeacherResponse(ctx context.Context, request domain.DialogTeacherRequest, idempotencyKey, body string) (domain.DialogMessage, error) {
	return client.appendTeacherResponse(ctx, request, idempotencyKey, body, nil)
}

func (client Client) AppendTeacherCoordinatedResponse(ctx context.Context, request domain.DialogTeacherRequest, idempotencyKey string, response domain.TeacherCoordinatedDialogResponse) (domain.DialogMessage, error) {
	normalized, err := domain.NewTeacherCoordinatedDialogResponse(response)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.DialogMessage{}, err
	}
	return client.appendTeacherResponse(ctx, request, idempotencyKey, normalized.Body, normalized.AssistantUI)
}

func (client Client) appendTeacherResponse(ctx context.Context, request domain.DialogTeacherRequest, idempotencyKey, body string, assistantUI json.RawMessage) (domain.DialogMessage, error) {
	normalized, err := domain.NewDialogTeacherRequest(request)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.DialogMessage{}, err
	}
	idempotencyKey = strings.TrimSpace(idempotencyKey)
	if _, err := uuid.Parse(idempotencyKey); err != nil || strings.TrimSpace(body) == "" {
		return domain.DialogMessage{}, domain.ErrInvalidDialogContext
	}
	payloadValue := map[string]any{
		"personal_teacher_id": normalized.PersonalTeacherID,
		"source_message_id":   normalized.SourceMessageID,
		"idempotency_key":     idempotencyKey,
		"body":                body,
	}
	if len(assistantUI) != 0 {
		payloadValue["assistant_ui"] = json.RawMessage(assistantUI)
	}
	payload, err := json.Marshal(payloadValue)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.DialogMessage{}, domain.ErrInvalidDialogContext
	}
	endpoint, err := client.endpoint("/internal/v1/teacher-dialog/" + url.PathEscape(normalized.DialogID) + "/message")
	if err != nil {
		return domain.DialogMessage{}, err
	}
	httpRequest, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodPost, endpoint, bytes.NewReader(payload))
	if err != nil {
		return domain.DialogMessage{}, unavailable(err)
	}
	httpRequest.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	client.authorize(httpRequest)
	response, err := client.do(httpRequest)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.DialogMessage{}, err
	}
	defer func() { _ = response.Body.Close() }()
	if response.StatusCode != http.StatusOK && response.StatusCode != http.StatusCreated {
		return domain.DialogMessage{}, mapStatus(response.StatusCode, response.Status)
	}
	var responsePayload messageResponse
	if err := decodeStrict(response.Body, &responsePayload); err != nil {
		return domain.DialogMessage{}, unavailable(err)
	}
	message, err := domain.NewDialogTeacherResponse(normalized, toDomainMessage(responsePayload))
	if err != nil || message.Body != body || !sameStagedAssistantUI(assistantUI, message.AssistantUI) {
		return domain.DialogMessage{}, unavailable(domain.ErrInvalidDialogContext)
	}
	return message, nil
}

func sameStagedAssistantUI(expected, actual json.RawMessage) bool {
	if len(expected) == 0 {
		return len(actual) == 0
	}
	expectedDigest, expectedErr := domain.DigestTeacherAssistantUI(expected)
	actualDigest, actualErr := domain.DigestTeacherAssistantUI(actual)
	return expectedErr == nil && actualErr == nil && expectedDigest == actualDigest
}

func (client Client) AppendTeacherProactive(ctx context.Context, binding domain.TeacherDialogBinding, idempotencyKey, body string) (domain.DialogMessage, error) {
	return client.appendTeacherProactive(ctx, binding, idempotencyKey, body, nil)
}

func (client Client) AppendTeacherStructuredProactive(ctx context.Context, binding domain.TeacherDialogBinding, idempotencyKey, body string, assistantUI json.RawMessage) (domain.DialogMessage, error) {
	if len(assistantUI) == 0 {
		return domain.DialogMessage{}, domain.ErrInvalidDialogContext
	}
	message, err := client.appendTeacherProactive(ctx, binding, idempotencyKey, body, assistantUI)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.DialogMessage{}, err
	}
	return domain.NewDialogTeacherStructuredProactive(binding, message, body, assistantUI)
}

func (client Client) appendTeacherProactive(ctx context.Context, binding domain.TeacherDialogBinding, idempotencyKey, body string, assistantUI json.RawMessage) (domain.DialogMessage, error) {
	normalized, err := domain.NewTeacherDialogBinding(binding)
	if err != nil || normalized.ContextType != domain.LearningContextGeneral {
		return domain.DialogMessage{}, domain.ErrInvalidDialogContext
	}
	idempotencyKey, body = strings.TrimSpace(idempotencyKey), strings.TrimSpace(body)
	if _, err := uuid.Parse(idempotencyKey); err != nil || body == "" {
		return domain.DialogMessage{}, domain.ErrInvalidDialogContext
	}
	requestPayload := map[string]any{
		"personal_teacher_id": normalized.PersonalTeacherID,
		"idempotency_key":     idempotencyKey, "body": body,
	}
	if len(assistantUI) != 0 {
		requestPayload["assistant_ui"] = assistantUI
	}
	payload, err := json.Marshal(requestPayload)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.DialogMessage{}, domain.ErrInvalidDialogContext
	}
	endpoint, err := client.endpoint("/internal/v1/teacher-dialog/" + url.PathEscape(normalized.ID) + "/proactive-message")
	if err != nil {
		return domain.DialogMessage{}, err
	}
	httpRequest, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodPost, endpoint, bytes.NewReader(payload))
	if err != nil {
		return domain.DialogMessage{}, unavailable(err)
	}
	httpRequest.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	client.authorize(httpRequest)
	response, err := client.do(httpRequest)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.DialogMessage{}, err
	}
	defer func() { _ = response.Body.Close() }()
	if response.StatusCode != http.StatusOK && response.StatusCode != http.StatusCreated {
		return domain.DialogMessage{}, mapStatus(response.StatusCode, response.Status)
	}
	var responsePayload messageResponse
	if err := decodeStrict(response.Body, &responsePayload); err != nil {
		return domain.DialogMessage{}, unavailable(err)
	}
	message, err := domain.NewDialogTeacherProactive(normalized, toDomainMessage(responsePayload))
	if err != nil || message.Body != body {
		return domain.DialogMessage{}, unavailable(domain.ErrInvalidDialogContext)
	}
	return message, nil
}

func (client Client) GetAssistantUISource(ctx context.Context, binding domain.TeacherDialogBinding, messageID string) (domain.DialogAssistantUISource, error) {
	normalized, err := domain.NewTeacherDialogBinding(binding)
	messageID = strings.TrimSpace(messageID)
	if err != nil || normalized.ContextType != domain.LearningContextGeneral {
		return domain.DialogAssistantUISource{}, domain.ErrInvalidDialogContext
	}
	if _, err := uuid.Parse(messageID); err != nil {
		return domain.DialogAssistantUISource{}, domain.ErrInvalidDialogContext
	}
	payload, err := json.Marshal(map[string]any{
		"student_id": normalized.StudentID, "personal_teacher_id": normalized.PersonalTeacherID, "message_id": messageID,
	})
	if err != nil {
		return domain.DialogAssistantUISource{}, domain.ErrInvalidDialogContext
	}
	endpoint, err := client.endpoint("/internal/v1/teacher-dialog/" + url.PathEscape(normalized.ID) + "/assistant-ui-source")
	if err != nil {
		return domain.DialogAssistantUISource{}, err
	}
	request, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodPost, endpoint, bytes.NewReader(payload))
	if err != nil {
		return domain.DialogAssistantUISource{}, unavailable(err)
	}
	request.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	client.authorize(request)
	response, err := client.do(request)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.DialogAssistantUISource{}, err
	}
	defer func() { _ = response.Body.Close() }()
	if response.StatusCode != http.StatusOK {
		return domain.DialogAssistantUISource{}, mapStatus(response.StatusCode, response.Status)
	}
	var source domain.DialogAssistantUISource
	if err := decodeStrict(response.Body, &source); err != nil {
		return domain.DialogAssistantUISource{}, unavailable(err)
	}
	if source.Schema != domain.DialogAssistantUISourceSchema || source.DialogID != normalized.ID ||
		source.StudentID != normalized.StudentID || source.PersonalTeacherID != normalized.PersonalTeacherID ||
		source.ContextType != "general_teacher" || source.ContextID != nil || source.MessageID != messageID ||
		source.MessageSequence < 1 || source.MessageVersion < 1 || len(source.AssistantUI) == 0 {
		return domain.DialogAssistantUISource{}, unavailable(domain.ErrInvalidDialogContext)
	}
	return source, nil
}

func (client Client) MaterializeCanonicalStudentTurn(ctx context.Context, input domain.CanonicalStudentTurnMaterialization) (domain.DialogMessage, error) {
	normalized, err := input.Normalize()
	if err != nil {
		return domain.DialogMessage{}, err
	}
	payload, err := json.Marshal(normalized)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.DialogMessage{}, domain.ErrInvalidDialogContext
	}
	endpoint, err := client.endpoint("/internal/v1/teacher-dialog/" + url.PathEscape(normalized.DialogID) + "/canonical-student-turn")
	if err != nil {
		return domain.DialogMessage{}, err
	}
	request, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodPost, endpoint, bytes.NewReader(payload))
	if err != nil {
		return domain.DialogMessage{}, unavailable(err)
	}
	request.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	client.authorize(request)
	response, err := client.do(request)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.DialogMessage{}, err
	}
	defer func() { _ = response.Body.Close() }()
	if response.StatusCode != http.StatusOK && response.StatusCode != http.StatusCreated {
		return domain.DialogMessage{}, mapStatus(response.StatusCode, response.Status)
	}
	var responsePayload messageResponse
	if err := decodeStrict(response.Body, &responsePayload); err != nil {
		return domain.DialogMessage{}, unavailable(err)
	}
	return domain.NewDialogCanonicalStudentTurn(domain.TeacherDialogBinding{ID: normalized.DialogID, StudentID: normalized.StudentID, PersonalTeacherID: normalized.PersonalTeacherID, ContextType: domain.LearningContextGeneral}, toDomainMessage(responsePayload), normalized)
}

func (client Client) AppendStudentChannelMessage(
	ctx context.Context,
	binding domain.TeacherDialogBinding,
	idempotencyKey string,
	channel domain.DialogMessageChannel,
	body string,
) (domain.DialogMessage, error) {
	normalized, err := domain.NewTeacherDialogBinding(binding)
	if err != nil || normalized.ContextType != domain.LearningContextGeneral || channel != domain.DialogMessageChannelTelegram {
		return domain.DialogMessage{}, domain.ErrInvalidDialogContext
	}
	idempotencyKey = strings.TrimSpace(idempotencyKey)
	if _, err := uuid.Parse(idempotencyKey); err != nil || strings.TrimSpace(body) == "" {
		return domain.DialogMessage{}, domain.ErrInvalidDialogContext
	}
	payload, err := json.Marshal(map[string]any{
		"student_id": normalized.StudentID, "personal_teacher_id": normalized.PersonalTeacherID,
		"idempotency_key": idempotencyKey, "channel": channel, "body": body,
	})
	if err != nil {
		return domain.DialogMessage{}, domain.ErrInvalidDialogContext
	}
	endpoint, err := client.endpoint("/internal/v1/teacher-dialog/" + url.PathEscape(normalized.ID) + "/student-channel-message")
	if err != nil {
		return domain.DialogMessage{}, err
	}
	request, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodPost, endpoint, bytes.NewReader(payload))
	if err != nil {
		return domain.DialogMessage{}, unavailable(err)
	}
	request.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	client.authorize(request)
	response, err := client.do(request)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.DialogMessage{}, err
	}
	defer func() { _ = response.Body.Close() }()
	if response.StatusCode != http.StatusOK && response.StatusCode != http.StatusCreated {
		return domain.DialogMessage{}, mapStatus(response.StatusCode, response.Status)
	}
	var responsePayload messageResponse
	if err := decodeStrict(response.Body, &responsePayload); err != nil {
		return domain.DialogMessage{}, unavailable(err)
	}
	message, err := domain.NewDialogStudentChannelMessage(normalized, toDomainMessage(responsePayload))
	if err != nil || message.Body != body {
		return domain.DialogMessage{}, unavailable(domain.ErrInvalidDialogContext)
	}
	return message, nil
}

func toDomainMessage(item messageResponse) domain.DialogMessage {
	return domain.DialogMessage{
		ID: item.ID, DialogID: item.DialogID, AuthorType: domain.DialogMessageAuthorType(item.AuthorType), Channel: domain.DialogMessageChannel(item.Channel),
		SenderID: optional(item.SenderID), PersonalTeacherID: optional(item.PersonalTeacherID),
		LearningActionID: optional(item.LearningActionID), ReplyToMessageID: optional(item.ReplyToMessageID),
		LessonContext: item.LessonContext, AssistantUI: item.AssistantUI,
		Body: item.Body, Status: item.Status, Version: item.Version, MessageSequence: item.MessageSequence,
		LastEventSequence: item.LastEventSequence, CreatedAt: item.CreatedAt,
	}
}

func normalizeContextType(value string) (domain.LearningContextType, error) {
	switch value {
	case "general_teacher":
		return domain.LearningContextGeneral, nil
	case string(domain.LearningContextLesson):
		return domain.LearningContextLesson, nil
	case string(domain.LearningContextLessonTask):
		return domain.LearningContextLessonTask, nil
	case string(domain.LearningContextPracticeTask):
		return domain.LearningContextPracticeTask, nil
	case string(domain.LearningContextProject):
		return domain.LearningContextProject, nil
	default:
		return "", domain.ErrInvalidDialogContext
	}
}

func optional(value *string) string {
	if value == nil {
		return ""
	}
	return *value
}

func (client Client) endpoint(path string) (string, error) {
	baseURL := strings.TrimRight(strings.TrimSpace(client.BaseURL), "/")
	if baseURL == "" || strings.TrimSpace(client.InternalToken) == "" {
		return "", unavailable(errors.New("dialog service URL and internal token are required"))
	}
	parsed, err := url.ParseRequestURI(baseURL + path)
	if err != nil || parsed.Scheme == "" || parsed.Host == "" {
		return "", unavailable(errors.New("invalid dialog service URL"))
	}
	return parsed.String(), nil
}

func (client Client) authorize(request *http.Request) {
	request.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", client.InternalToken)
}

func (client Client) do(request *http.Request) (*http.Response, error) {
	httpClient := client.HTTPClient
	if httpClient == nil {
		httpClient = &http.Client{Timeout: 3 * time.Second}
	}
	response, err := httpClient.Do(request)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, unavailable(err)
	}
	return response, nil
}

func decodeStrict(reader io.Reader, target any) error {
	limited := &io.LimitedReader{R: reader, N: maximumResponseBytes + 1}
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(limited)
	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if err := decoder.Decode(target); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := decoder.Decode(&struct{}{}); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
		return errors.New("dialog response must contain one JSON value")
	}
	if limited.N == 0 {
		return errors.New("dialog response exceeds size limit")
	}
	return nil
}

func mapStatus(statusCode int, status string) error {
	switch statusCode {
	case http.StatusNotFound:
		return domain.ErrDialogRequestNotFound
	case http.StatusBadRequest, http.StatusForbidden, http.StatusConflict:
		return domain.ErrInvalidDialogContext
	default:
		return unavailable(fmt.Errorf("unexpected dialog response %s", status))
	}
}

func unavailable(cause error) error {
	return fmt.Errorf("%w: %v", domain.ErrDialogStateUnavailable, cause)
}

var _ repository.DialogRequestContextReader = Client{}
var _ repository.DialogTeacherResponseAppender = Client{}
var _ repository.DialogTeacherCoordinatedResponseAppender = Client{}
var _ repository.DialogTeacherProactiveAppender = Client{}
var _ repository.DialogTeacherStructuredProactiveAppender = Client{}
var _ repository.DialogAssistantUISourceReader = Client{}
var _ repository.DialogStudentChannelAppender = Client{}
var _ repository.TeacherDialogProvisioner = Client{}
